dossier.valuation_method: Probability-weighted, option-like residual-equity valuation: bottoms-up rNPV of AP-SA02 (eligible SAB population -> penetration -> net price -> exclusivity, with stated ex-US scaling) plus minor pipeline option value (enterprise ~$99M), cross-checked against antibacterial/phage M&A comps, netted against the senior secured Innoviva claim (~$140M today, compounding 14% toward ~$400M+ by approval) with an explicit financing-path split, internally-consistent treasury-method/conversion logic (convertible converts only if per-share > $1.52; warrants/options exercise only if ITM), state-contingent shares (~37-72M), and an explicit Innoviva take-out model; PV'd at ~14% with an explicit size/illiquidity premium.
dossier.thesis_summary: Armata is effectively a single-asset phage biotech (AP-SA02 for S. aureus bacteremia) whose common is a deeply subordinated residual behind ~$140M of senior secured Innoviva debt that compounds at 14% and is held by the ~84% controlling owner. Risk-weighted pipeline value (~$99M) barely exceeds the senior claim, so common is an out-of-the-money option worth ~$0.47/share, ~94% below the ~$7.5-8 implied market price and far below $9-15 sell-side targets. The gap is mostly mechanical (subordination + dilution the market under-weights), not a dispute about the science.
key_value_drivers: AP-SA02 Phase 3 probability of success in complicated S. aureus bacteremia (~34% base case)
Financing path: partner-funded Phase 3 (debt stays ~$170M) vs Innoviva-debt-funded (claim compounds to ~$400M+) — decisive for whether equity captures value
Size of the senior secured Innoviva claim at monetization and whether Innoviva shares vs consolidates/squeezes
Peak-sales magnitude / whether a mortality-benefit (premium) label materializes (bottoms-up ~$50M flop / ~$220M solid / ~$690M premium global)
State-contingent fully diluted shares and convertible-conversion threshold ($1.52): ~37M (OTM states) / ~56M (solid) / ~72M (premium)
key_risks: Phase 3 failure (base case) — exebacase adjunctive-SAB precedent failed the same design
Going-concern: $4.75M cash vs ~$6M/qtr burn; survival depends entirely on continued Innoviva financing
Minority squeeze/foreclosure/cheap-conversion/take-private risk given Innoviva is owner+senior lender+board controller
Antibacterial commercial graveyard (Achaogen, Melinta, Tetraphase) caps peak sales even on approval
Senior secured debt compounding at 14% subordinates and dilutes common in nearly every state
Actionability: ~84% control and ~6M float create squeeze risk that makes the mispricing hard/risky to monetize
what_would_change_my_mind: A third-party partnership/acquisition of AP-SA02 bringing non-Innoviva cash and an arms-length price above the senior claim
Phase 3 confirmation/replication of the mortality-benefit signal
Equity (rather than 14% senior debt) financing that halts the senior-claim compounding
Evidence Innoviva intends to share upside with the float rather than consolidate cheaply

judge_gaps: Underweights the true crux for the float: because Innoviva owns 84% of the equity AND holds the debt, the 'debt dominates equity' outcome for minorities is a discretionary governance/extraction choice, not a mechanical inevitability — a best-in-class report would foreground and probability-weight Innoviva's conduct (realize-and-share vs squeeze) more explicitly rather than framing the gap as 'mostly mechanical.'
The extraordinary ~16x magnitude still rests on irreducible PoS (~34%) and tail-EV judgment inputs (acknowledged by the author, but it caps confidence in the point estimate).
Current-period management Q&A remains unquoted (genuine, non-fabricable tool limitation; a top report would source the latest call/PR Q&A on partnership and financing intent from another channel).
Live share price is data-derived/implied rather than a confirmed quote given documented intraday volatility — handled candidly but a small precision gap for a price-dependent thesis.
